description_ko: 영상 특징과 픽셀 구조 변화에 따른 형태 및 존재 변화 가능성 감지.
original_description: 영상 특징과 픽셀 구조가 함께 변한 구간입니다. 형태·존재 변화 가능성을 확인하세요.
normal_alternative: 카메라/대상 움직임, 가림, 장면 전환, 조명 변화 또는 의도된 연출

description_ko: 샐러드가 공중에 경직된 채 떠 있다가 그릇으로 떨어지고, 요리사의 손과 자세가 비정상적으로 멈추거나 사라짐.
original_description: The salad arrangement floats rigidly in air and drops neatly into a bowl while the chef's hands and body posture freeze or vanish unnaturally behind it.
normal_alternative: A composite visual effect or stop-motion edit used in creative video production.

description_ko: 던져 올린 샐러드가 공중에서 단단한 덩어리 형태를 유지하며 흩어지지 않고 그릇으로 내려옴.
original_description: The tossed salad mass solidifies mid-air, maintaining a rigid, static structure without separating as it hovers and descends into the bowl.
normal_alternative: Intentional stop-motion or freeze-frame compositing effect.

description_ko: 요리사 재킷 아래 중앙에 반투명 5-MINUTE CRAFTS 워터마크가 나타나며 불투명도가 변함.
original_description: A semi-transparent '5-MINUTE CRAFTS' text watermark appears and fluctuates in opacity across the lower-center of the chef's jacket.

description_ko: 위에서 채소가 던져지는 동안 볼 안에서 채소가 갑자기 나타나고 복제됨.
original_description: Vegetables suddenly manifest and duplicate inside the bowl while vegetables are tossed above.
normal_alternative: Bowl remains with initial contents until falling vegetables land inside.

description_ko: 위로 떠오른 양배추가 동적으로 변형되고 부자연스럽게 공중에 맴돌다가 떨어짐.
original_description: Cabbage floating upward transforms dynamically and hovers unnaturally before falling.
normal_alternative: Realistic ballistic trajectory without mid-air shape-shifting.

description_ko: 공중에 던져진 샐러드가 버거/샌드위치 형태로 뭉쳐 공중에 떠다니다가 그릇으로 내려앉음
original_description: Tossed salad solidifies into a structured burger/sandwich stack floating mid-air, drifts upwards, hovers, and descends into the bowl.
normal_alternative: Individual pieces of tossed vegetables scattering and falling downward into the bowl under gravity.

description_ko: 샐러드가 지나갈 때 요리사의 얼굴이 눈 크기 왜곡, 부분 투명화, 얼굴 변형 등으로 일그러짐
original_description: Chef's face distorts with abnormal eye scaling, partial transparency, and face deformation as the salad passes over it.
normal_alternative: Stable facial features partially obscured normally by foreground objects.

description_ko: 던져 올린 샐러드가 층진 단단한 덩어리가 되어 요리사의 얼굴·모자 앞에 떠 있다가 한 덩어리로 그릇에 내려옴.
original_description: The tossed salad mass solidifies into a rigid layered clump that hovers in front of the chef's face and hat before descending back into the bowl as a single unit.
normal_alternative: Intentional surreal or stop-motion style visual effect.

description_ko: 당근·양파·상추 조각이 그릇과 이어지는 연속 경로 없이 얼굴·모자·옷 주변 공중에 나타나 떠 있거나 사라짐.
original_description: Loose vegetable pieces (carrot, onion, lettuce) materialize, hover, and vanish in mid-air around the chef's face, hat, and coat without following a continuous trajectory from or into the bowl.

description_ko: 하늘에 떠 있는 실오라기/뱀 모양 리본이 자발적으로 나타나 뱀 같은 형태로 변형됨
original_description: Floating wisps/serpentine ribbons spontaneously manifest and alter morphology into snake-like figures in the sky.
normal_alternative: Consistent transformation or motion of stylized wind/sound effects.

description_ko: 소년의 입과 입술이 피리 부근에서 불규칙하게 뒤틀리며, 일관된 입 움직임이나 부는 동작으로 보이지 않음.
original_description: The boy's mouth and lips warp and shift shape erratically against the flute without coherent lip-syncing or blowing motion.
normal_alternative: Stylized 2D animation of a child blowing into a flute.

description_ko: 하늘 왼쪽 위의 노란 리본 모양 양 끝이 검은 점 모양 눈을 가진 뱀 머리 형태로 변함.
original_description: The upper-left yellow ribbon-like shape in the sky morphs its two ends into snake-like heads with black dots for eyes.
normal_alternative: Intentional fantasy or surreal transformation of musical wind ribbons into creatures.

description_ko: 하늘 오른쪽 노란 리본의 윗부분이 눈과 벌어지는 턱이 있는 뱀 또는 새 머리 형태로 변함.
original_description: The top end of the right-side yellow ribbon in the sky morphs into a snake or bird-like head with an eye and an opening jaw.
normal_alternative: Intentional fantasy animation where wind/music ribbons turn into living shapes.

description_ko: 왼쪽 뱀의 머리가 구름 모양에 감싸여 녹아들며 변형된 후 완전히 사라짐
original_description: The head of the left snake gets enveloped and dissolved by the cloud shape, briefly morphing and vanishing before disappearing entirely.
normal_alternative: Natural movement or consistent occlusion by foreground elements.

description_ko: 소녀의 손에 들린 플루트의 각도와 방향이 입과 손가락에 대해 부자연스럽게 뒤틀림
original_description: The flute's angle and orientation shift unnaturally in the girl's hands, twisting abruptly relative to her mouth and fingers as she plays.
normal_alternative: A rigid instrument held steadily across the mouth with consistent alignment.

description_ko: 소녀가 피리를 들어 올릴 때 나무 피리 몸통의 검은 손가락 구멍들이 완전히 사라짐.
original_description: As the girl raises the flute, the dark finger holes along the wooden body of the instrument vanish completely.
normal_alternative: The flute rotates slightly, though the angle is insufficient to fully occlude the holes.

description_ko: 가운데 구름 뱀의 둥근 아랫부분이 오른쪽으로 뻗는 뾰족한 꼬리로 변하고, 오른쪽 구름 뱀 몸통 중간에 작은 코브라 머리가 생김.
original_description: The lower tip of the central cloud-snake morphs from a rounded end into a pointed tail that extends to the right, and the cloud-snake on the right sprouts a small cobra head mid-body.
normal_alternative: Intentional magical cloud transformation in an animated fantasy scene.
